big_case.notes: Whether a State may bar carry across transit, parks, health-care facilities, entertainment venues, alcohol-serving premises and demonstrations is the main open post-Bruen question, on a final judgment with a divided Fourth Circuit panel; a merits ruling would have governed carry-location statutes nationwide. The Court denied after five distributions with a Thomas statement respecting denial, so the case sets no national rule; the stakes are real but unrealised, and it drew a single cert-stage amicus brief.
